name: Revdoku
description: Create and manage email mailboxes for AI agents, with cloud storage for emails, attachments, and files.
capabilities: Create and manage email mailboxes for AI agents
Receive email and attachments at each mailbox's incoming address
List messages with polling cursors, read decoded email, and download originals and attachments with email tools
Store documents, data, and source files in private cloud mailboxes
Share mailbox files with authorized people and AI connections
Read, write, and append shared files; coordinate edits with locks and revision checks
Inspect versions and change history; restore earlier files
